statements.t: During the third quarter of 2025, we reached an agreement with the Emilia Romagna Region (the "Intesa") in support of our pending application for a production concession related to the Gradizza field, representing a critical regulatory step in the advancement of the project.
During the nine months ended September 30, 2026, we commenced construction activities at the Gradizza field development project.
Gradizza is expected to become our first wholly owned and operated production asset and reflects our strategy of increasing exposure to operated assets with long-term production potential.

The transition from the existing temporary production facilities to permanent production infrastructure represents an important milestone in the maturation of the concession and is expected to support our long-term development.
Upon completion, the permanent facility is expected to improve production operations and provide a stronger foundation for the continued development of one of the Company’s core assets.

With the construction of the permanent processing facility at Longanesi expected to be completed over the remainder of 2026 and into early 2027, we anticipate further improvements in production operations and operational efficiency.

We expect to continue to incur expenses to support operations as a public company, including expenses related to existing and future compliance with rules and regulations of the SEC and the Nasdaq, insurance expenses, investor relations, audit fees, professional services and general overhead and administrative costs .

We expect to continue to incur substantial expenses related to our operations, exploration, and development activities, including pre-commercialization efforts as we continue our development of, and seek regulatory approval for, our discoveries and exploration pros pects.

We expect to fund the remaining contingent consideration payments under the Longanesi Purchase Agreement, which are determined by sales volumes and spot natural gas prices, during the Earn-Out Period (as defined below), from cash on hand and cash flows from operations.

In addition, we are exploring Resource Backed Loan (“RBL”) financing, renewable natural gas project loan products and other financing arrangements with several financial institutions; however, there is no guarantee that such financing will be available to us.
We are constructing a permanent processing facility at our Longanesi site, which we expect to complete during the remainder of 2026 and into early 2027.

We expect to fund these capital requirements, together with our other capital needs, through a combination of cash on hand, cash flows from operations and, if necessary, borrowings under financing arrangements.

The failure of an operator of our wells or joint venture participant to adequately perform operations, an operator’s breach of the applicable agreements or an operator’s failure to act in ways that are in our best interest could reduce our production and revenues.
We expect to be an emerging growth company at least through 2026.
